pages.text: SF Rush the Rock Field Service Bulletin U17 Heatsink It has come to our attention that some SF Rush the Rock CPU boards (PN. #’s A-21937) may exhibit a reset problem. Symptoms are: the game freezes then re-boots during game play. To fix this timing error, solder a 10pF 10% axial capacitor (part # 5048-12503-00) from the load side of R571 to the ground side of C310. See below for an exploded view of the exact location on the board of the added capacitor. U17 Heatsink If you have any questions please call Atari Games at
